versions.changelog:
- Skill description shortened to "Get the current macOS Focus mode"
- Removed mention of "to know if Nick is sleeping, working out, etc." from description

Initial release of get-focus-mode.

- Provides the active macOS Focus mode name ("No Focus", "Office", "Sleep", "Do Not Disturb").
- Outputs the mode name to stdout for use in scripts and automation.
- Requires macOS and jq.
